context_for_next_testing_agent: Purchase Invoice and Job Work modules fully implemented and tested. Key features: (1) Purchase Invoice: Create with GST calculation, Approve (admin only), Mark Paid (admin only) - status flow: draft→approved→paid. (2) Job Work: Create subcontract order, Confirm, Send DC (deducts stock, creates inventory transaction), Receive (adds stock, tracks accepted/rejected qty) - order auto-completes when all materials received. (3) Sidebar reorganized with Inventory group containing Stock, Items & Parts, Suppliers, MRP, Purchase Orders, Purchase Invoices. Test file: /app/backend/tests/test_purchase_invoice_jobwork.py
